#!/usr/bin/env python3
# OANKS Phase System - Self-Extracting Termux/Ubuntu Edition
# Run: python3 oanks_selfextract.py --run-phase phase1

import os, sys, base64, zipfile, tempfile, argparse, importlib.util

ZIP_DATA = """UEsDBBQAAAAAAPOIEF0AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAMAAAAX19weWNhY2hlX18vUEsDBBQAAAAIAPOIEF2NK7np..."""  # Truncated for display - will be full data

# Full data is appended after this marker
# ===ZIP_DATA_BELOW===

# ===ZIP_DATA_BELOW===
ZIP_DATA = ""

PHASES_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".oanks_phases")

def extract():
    if os.path.exists(PHASES_DIR) and os.path.exists(os.path.join(PHASES_DIR, "oanks.py")):
        return
    os.makedirs(PHASES_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    zip_bytes = base64.b64decode(ZIP_DATA)
    zip_path = os.path.join(PHASES_DIR, "temp.zip")
    with open(zip_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(zip_bytes)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
        z.extractall(PHASES_DIR)
    os.remove(zip_path)
    print("[OANKS] Extracted to " + PHASES_DIR)

def run_phase(phase_name):
    filepath = os.path.join(PHASES_DIR, phase_name + ".py")
    if not os.path.exists(filepath):
        print("[ERROR] Phase not found: " + filepath)
        return False
    try:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(phase_name, filepath)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[phase_name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        print("[OANKS] " + phase_name + " loaded successfully")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print("[ERROR] " + str(e))
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        return False

def run_all():
    phases = [f.replace(".py", "") for f in sorted(os.listdir(PHASES_DIR)) if f.startswith("phase") and f.endswith(".py")]
    print("[OANKS] Found " + str(len(phases)) + " phases")
    for phase in phases:
        print("\n" + "="*60)
        run_phase(phase)
    print("\n[OANKS] All phases complete.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    extract()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--run-all", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--run-phase", type=str)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.run_all:
        run_all()
    elif args.run_phase:
        run_phase(args.run_phase)
    else:
        parser.print_help()
        print("\nExample: python3 oanks_selfextract.py --run-phase phase1")
